feeds.title: New Día Cannabis Co. Blog
feeds.description: New Dia Cannabis Co., located in the heart of Boston's Fenway Park area, prides itself on being the East Coast's first cannabis mall. This unique establishment offers a one-of-a-kind experience for both locals and tourists. New Dia's mission is to revolutionize the cannabis retail sector by providing an immersive shopping experience coupled with an events space, all designed to foster a collaborative, inclusive, and progressive environment​​.
